meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 增加能力或修改行为:加新输入渠道、加集成、改触发规则或路由。它会先提问弄清你要什么,再动手改,并告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)、加集成,或改触发规则、路由等自定义时接管,动手前先提问确认需求。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加成一个新的输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问你接到哪个 agent group、用什么隔离级别

say.text: 给这个 agent group 加上 Google 日历的 MCP 工具
say.note: 写进该组的 container config 后重启生效

say.text: 改一下这个 wiring 的触发规则
say.note: 用 ncl wirings update 更新后生效

howto.what_en: Adds capabilities or changes NanoClaw behavior: new input channels, integrations, trigger rules, router changes. It asks clarifying questions first, makes the change, then tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a channel (e.g. Telegram, Slack), an integration, or modify triggers, routing or other NanoClaw customizations; it asks clarifying questions before changing anything.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as a new input channel
say_en.note: It asks which agent group and isolation level first

say_en.text: Add the Google Calendar MCP tool to this agent group
say_en.note: Written to the group's container config, then restart

say_en.text: Change the trigger rules on this wiring
